variant.changelog:
Gratis 0.1.0.7

First submission to the testing channel.

- A flat, minimal replacement for the in-game map: search, lenses, filters, quest log and window presets.
- Click a quest marker to open that quest in the Quest Log.
- Instance quests point at the entry NPC or door.
- A separate map size and position inside duties.

variant.author: t3sco (based on Mappy by MidoriKami, harbingerftw)
variant.changelog:
Gratis 0.1.2.1

- New FATE button beside the Quest Log: lists the FATEs on your map with level, progress, time left and distance. FATEs with the EXP bonus show a gold + on the map.
- New Shared FATE button: your Shared FATE progress in the Gratis style.
- Your pet, party pets and striking dummies now appear on the map.
- Grab any edge of the map to move it and any corner to resize it. Shift-drag also moves the window (on by default, can be switched off).
- Map labels no longer flip between positions while your character runs.

variant.author: t3sco (based on Mappy by MidoriKami, harbingerftw)
variant.changelog:
Gratis 0.1.2.2

- Centre on open now works every time you open the map, not only the first.
- Quick Setup asks whether the arrow and view cone follow your character or your camera (Settings > Map > Markers > Arrow and cone follow).
- Quest circles have their own colours, blue by default (Settings > Map > Markers > Quest area fill, with Show advanced settings on).
- Pins on the map have their own icon, distinct from a real flag.
- The quest log pin moved into the journal header.
- New option: location text inside the toolbar (Settings > Controls > Cards & motion > Location text position).
- The Classic toolbar now lines up flush with the top of the map.
- Fixed segmented buttons sometimes not lighting up when clicked, and quest markers from another floor showing on the wrong map.
- Feedback can carry an optional Discord handle.
